titulo_es: Connectors in an explanation · Cause, consequence and concession

texto: «Fordi» introduces a cause with prayer; «derfor» has a consequence and, at the beginning of a main, causes investment. «Selvom» presents a difficulty that does not invalidate the main idea.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
